newsitem.title: CHINA: China central bank may issue debt in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China central bank may issue debt in 1997.

text.p: China's central bank may issue debt on a trial basis in 1997, the official Financial News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper gave no details of the size or timing of the possible issue. Government debt is normally issued by the Finance Ministry or as project bonds by other ministries.
China is expected to issue about 250 billion yuan ($30.1 billion) worth of government debt this year compared with 195.2 billion last year.
Beijing is trying to develop its bond market by issuing new types of debt.

It is issuing 20 billion yuan of discounted bonds this month that will be listed on domestic stock exchanges. These were offered through an auction system with no fixed price for the secondary market. ($1 = 8.3 yuan) -- Beijing newsroom (8610) 6532-1921
